stem: A mechanism has four independent one-DOF joint coordinates and performs a task whose local Jacobian rank is three. At this regular configuration, which redundancy conclusion is valid?

options.text: There is one local redundant direction because 4−3=1
There is no redundancy because the mechanism has fewer than six coordinates
There are three redundant directions because the task rank is three
There are four redundant directions because every joint coordinate is redundant

assumptions: The four coordinates are independent configuration variables; task rank is exactly three. No additional active constraints are imposed.
